synthetic-cfa.dng is an original 128×96, uncompressed 12-bit-value Bayer
RGGB sensor fixture in a 16-bit DNG container. It contains three analytic
colour gradients, an identity camera colour matrix, D65 illuminant and
neutral white balance. It contains no photograph or book artwork.
It exercises actual LibRaw demosaicing and colour development, not an
embedded JPEG preview. A Sony ARW was also decoded manually during review;
the 32 MB third-party camera sample is not distributed in this repository.

astronaut.png: NASA photograph of astronaut Eileen Collins, public domain;
retrieved from scikit-image v0.20.0/skimage/data/astronaut.png. Used only as a
human-subject inference test input, not as application/sample artwork.
Source: https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.20.0/skimage/data/astronaut.png
